summary: Iteration 6 testing complete for admin httpOnly cookie-based authentication migration. All 15 backend tests passed, all 4 frontend tests passed. The migration from localStorage JWT to httpOnly cookie session management is working correctly.

✅ Protected endpoints (pending-payments, pending-quotes, all-bookings, daily-schedule) return 401 without cookie
✅ Protected endpoints work correctly WITH valid cookie
✅ Frontend AdminLogin.js uses axios with withCredentials: true
